title: Earthily Smoky Italian Eggplant Cassata
description: A smoky and comforting Italian dish featuring eggplant and parmigiano-reggiano, with a plant-based friendly twist, using sous-vide for tender results.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the eggplant slices with salt and let them sit for 30 minutes to draw out excess moisture.
Rinse the eggplant slices and pat them dry with paper towels.
Sous-vide the eggplant slices at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes to tenderize them.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the smoked paprika and oil.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked eggplant slices, tomato sauce mixture, and chopped basil.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the eggplant mixture, followed by a layer of shaved parmigiano-reggiano and vegan mozzarella.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
